entries.title: VS Code v1_122: GitHub Copilot moves to usage based billing
entries.description: GitHub Copilot has moved tousage-based billing. Under the new model, each interaction consumes AI credits, which are calculated based on token (input, output, and cached) cost and on the model used. Complex interactions and more capable models consume more credits, while lightweight models and simpler tasks use fewer. Learn more about how you canoptimize your usage.
